name: Manastorm Sunken Temple: solo Jammal'an does not full-heal when his Hex charms the only attacker (#8129)
contract: #8129: in a solo Manastorm run of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, Jammal'an the Prophet's Hex of Jammal'an
charms the lone player (spell 12483). With no other threat left in his list, generic evade logic used to
reset him to full health and drop combat the instant the charm landed. The fix suppresses that evade for
the charm's duration so the fight continues once control returns; it never changes the charm or the boss.
This scenario proves setup correctness (private run, phase match, immune-to-PC window cleared, combat
engaged, Chaotic Link present, player not pre-charmed), then forces the charm directly with
'.cast back 12483 triggered' so Jammal'an himself (the selected creature) casts it onto the invoking
player, exactly as his own SmartAI In-Combat timer eventually would, without waiting on that timer.
Both '.cast back' and '.cast target' need a native CMSG_SET_SELECTION first
CMSG_ATTACKSWING and never selects. An earlier attempt at a forced cast skipped that selection, failed
with 'select character or creature', and was misread as an RBAC permission gap. The new select_nearby
harness action (apps/coa-gameplay-test) sends the missing selection. '.cast back' (not '.cast target')
is used because it targets the invoking player directly and does not depend on Creature::GetVictim()
already pointing at the player, which made an earlier attempt with '.cast target' intermittently fail
under batch load before the AuraScript's own gate (caster entry, instance, Solo mode -- see
ManastormSunkenTempleCompat.cpp) ever got a say. The closing assertions confirm the player is actually
charmed and that Jammal'an neither evaded (his Chaotic Link encounter aura would be stripped by
Unit::RemoveEvadeAuras() on a real evade, and it survives here) nor dropped out of combat.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura
Jammal'an's native 5s out-of-combat immune-to-PC window has cleared
CONTROL: the player is not charmed before Jammal'an's curse is cast
CONTROL: Jammal'an's Chaotic Link encounter aura is present before the charm
Jammal'an is engaged and attackable ahead of the charm (setup is otherwise correct)
Select Jammal'an so '.cast back' can resolve him as the caster
Let a little real combat happen before forcing the cast
The player is charmed by Jammal'an's Hex
Jammal'an did not evade: his Chaotic Link encounter aura survives the charm
Jammal'an did not evade: he is still attackable, not reset out of combat
